summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat reported that Ben Hogan deposited $500 as a forfeit with Jack Looney to fight Tom Allen for $2,000 a side, thirty days after the McCoole and Allen fight.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Monday, September 15, 1873' (pre-merger; not yet the Globe-Democrat).

facts.fact: Ben Hogan, in St. Louis, deposited a $500 forfeit with Jack Looney to fight Allen for $2,000 a side, win or lose, thirty days after the McCoole–Allen fight, the money open to be covered by Allen or his friends
places: Jack Looney's, 422 North Fourth street, St. Louis

notes: The challenge is entirely about Allen, so focus raised to primary. Related to the later Allen–Hogan match (facts-index '000: ... Allen was set to fight [Ben?] Hogan') but not the same fact.
